comment: The pinned orchard release. Edited only by a deliberate update, never to silence a failure. assets[] are download hashes and change when an archive is repacked; files[] are content hashes and change only when the words do. v1.1.0 changed every archive hash and no content hash. v1.6.0 is Bea's second curation batch: four of the five lists moved and definitions.tsv gained three rows, so common-pool.txt and etymology.tsv are the two content hashes that did not change while all three archive hashes did. See scripts/update-lexicon.ts.
